title: docs: update Flux pricing
author: AbarnaaSree
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

* Update the outdated Flux pricing information in `enter.pollinations.ai/AGENTS.md`
* Change the documentation from describing Flux as free to the current price of 0.002 Pollen per image

## Issue Number

Fixes #14723

gist.headline: Flux gets a price tag
gist.blurb: The Flux sign in the garden has been corrected: each image costs 0.002 Pollen. Tiny labels, fewer surprises.
gist.summary: Updated enter.pollinations.ai/AGENTS.md to replace the outdated claim that Flux images are free with the current price of 0.002 Pollen per image.
gist.impact: Developers reading the Flux documentation now get the current 0.002-Pollen-per-image cost when planning image generation.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy documentation update represented by Polli carefully replacing an old "FREE" placard with a small, clear "0.002 POLLEN / IMAGE" sign beside a flourishing Flux image plant. A nearby retro terminal and soft garden flowers make the pricing information feel like useful upkeep rather than a warning.
